patch.sql:
select
    l_orderkey || '-' || l_linenumber as order_line_id,
    l_orderkey as order_key,
    l_linenumber as line_number,
    l_partkey as part_key,
    l_suppkey as supplier_key,
    l_quantity as quantity,
    l_extended_price as extended_price,
    l_discount as discount,
    l_tax as tax,
    l_returnflag as return_flag,
    l_shipdate as ship_date,
    l_extended_price * (1 - l_discount) as net_revenue
from {{ source('raw', 'lineitem') }}
patch.explanation: The source table raw.lineitem uses column name `l_extended_price` (with an underscore) instead of the previously referenced `l_extendedprice`. This caused a binder error during model compilation. Updated the staging model to reference the correct column name in both the column selection and the net_revenue calculation, preserving all other column names, aliases, and types.
